mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_ticket (ticket_no, user_id, conversation_id, question, root_cause, status) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{question}, #{rootCause}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_no, user_id, conversation_id, question, root_cause, status, assignee, reply, created_at, updated_at, resolved_at FROM ai_ticket WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, ticket_no, user_id, conversation_id, question, root_cause, status, assignee, reply, created_at, updated_at, resolved_at FROM ai_ticket WHERE ticket_no = #{ticketNo}

SELECT id, ticket_no, user_id, conversation_id, question, root_cause, status, assignee, reply, created_at, updated_at, resolved_at FROM ai_ticket WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_ticket SET reply = #{reply}, assignee = #{assignee}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now(), resolved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') THEN now() ELSE resolved_at END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_ticket SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now(), resolved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') THEN now() ELSE resolved_at END WHERE id = #{id}
